reader_summary.headline: Joel Greenblatt beats the market without taking excessive risks.
reader_summary.overview: Many investors fail to match the performance of the funds they buy. Great investor Joel Greenblatt solved this problem with his Gotham Index Plus Fund. Since starting in 2015, this fund has outperformed the market while keeping investors calm.

key_points.text: The Gotham Index Plus Fund has beaten the market since its 2015 inception.

key_points.text: The fund achieves strong returns without spooking investors.

reader_summary.why_it_matters: Listeners learn how to beat the market without taking excessive risks.
